supporting_evidence.summary: significant deviations in scope [all services]: recommendationservice_latency-90 z=173.44 (867.2%); recommendationservice_latency-50 z=155.9 (779.5%); recommendationservice_cpu z=67.44 (655.6%); frontend_latency-50 z=5.89 (29.5%)
traces for recommendationservice: SIGNIFICANT change; own spans self-time p50 1.04->2.57ms (2.48x), errors 0.0->0.0; inbound calls self-time p50 3.88->5.43ms (1.4x), errors 0.0->0.0

alternatives_rejected.why: Frontend p50 latency rose only 29.5% (z=5.89), versus about 780-870% for recommendationservice latency (E1). That fits downstream impact from a slow callee, not an origin.

It shows no significant deviation in the all-services metric ranking (E1). The slowdown is in recommendationservice's own span self-time (2.48x), which excludes time spent in child calls, so it is not inherited from a dependency (E2).

proposed_fix.description: Find and stop the CPU-hogging workload or process in the recommendationservice pod. Meanwhile, scale out recommendationservice replicas and raise its CPU limit to bring latency back to baseline, then confirm that its CPU and p50/p90 latency normalize.
